name: Good Type Foundry · Ridder

title.zh: Good Type Foundry · 比较零售字族

description.zh: 点进Ridder往下拉：大小写与重音数字网格摊开，合用与否一看便知 Good Type Foundry AS 经营的零售与定制字体厂，设计出版当代零售字族并提供品牌定制、字母与语言扩展服务。零售字体按自有 EULA 授权使用，另提供残缺字符集的试用字体，需登录下载、仅供测试。
description.en: Good Type Foundry AS runs a retail and custom type foundry designing contemporary retail families and brand custom work, lettering and language extensions. Retail fonts use its own EULA, with trial fonts in a limited character set for testing only and login required to download.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Good Type Foundry (https://goodtypefoundry.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 点进Ridder往下拉：大小写与重音数字网格摊开，合用与否一看便知

Visual details from source observation: 我们先在首页认出字厂名称和当期字族展示，再到Trial Fonts查看字族名单、基础字符表与登录下载入口；这里展示的是试用范围，不等于逐款字形都已测试。Ridder详情能直接看不规则衬线轮廓和数字样张，适合先判断字体性格。Trial仅供测试，正式项目须按零售EULA核Desktop或Web授权；本次未登录、下载或购买。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
